- Thursday: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00

**Marcus Hale's free slots:**

Now I will find the intersection of these free slots to find the times when both Priya and Marcus are available.

I will now post this list of common available times to the workspace for Brad. This will allow him to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.
